capability.summary: Compute a SHA-256 digest for one UTF-8 string
capability.description: Encodes the supplied string as UTF-8, hashes it with cryptography's SHA256 implementation, and returns the lowercase hexadecimal digest.
capability.problem_space: Deterministic integrity fingerprinting for one text value; this wrapper does not encrypt, sign, verify, or handle binary input directly.

constraint.io_signature: Input: data string and an operation string; output: JSON object with algorithm SHA256 and digest hex text. The operation argument is accepted but ignored by the implementation.
accepted_inputs: a string whose UTF-8 bytes should be hashed
any operation string, although only SHA256 hashing is actually performed
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.cryptography_hash_sign", algorithm fixed to "SHA256", and digest as the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest string. A caught encoding or hashing exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.cryptography_hash_sign", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: does not encrypt or decrypt data
does not create or verify digital signatures
always uses SHA-256 regardless of operation value
hashes the UTF-8 encoding of text rather than caller-supplied raw bytes

output_contract.description: SHA-256 hexadecimal digest for the supplied UTF-8 string.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: calculate a SHA-256 hash of text
produce a hexadecimal digest for a string
negative_intents: hash arbitrary binary bytes with a caller-selected algorithm
